scripts.build: bun run build:shared && bun run --filter='./packages/*' --filter='!@conduit/shared' build
scripts.build:client: bun run build:shared && bun run --filter=@conduit/client build
scripts.build:server: bun run build:shared && bun run --filter=@conduit/server build
scripts.build:admin: bun run build:shared && bun run --filter=@conduit/admin build
scripts.test: bun run --filter='./packages/*' test && bun run --filter=@conduit/examples test
scripts.test:cluster: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml --profile cluster up -d redis && bun run --filter=@conduit/server test:cluster
scripts.typecheck: bun run build:shared && bun run --filter='./packages/*' typecheck && bun run --filter='./packages/*' typecheck:test
